analysis:
The three supplied files are documentation-only; no code, config or workflow changes are visible, so I found no concrete security regression.

- docs/architecture/model-registry.md (head 17-22): adds a ModelMediaPolicy.advertisesMedia note. Staged nemotron_h_omni checkpoints do not advertise media, matched on trimmed, case-insensitive architecture. This is a restrictive guard and does not register the model. The implementing Swift file (ProviderCoreFoundation/ModelMediaPolicy.swift) was not supplied, so the doc claim is unverified.
- docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md: bumps the date. The resident recurrent-checkpoint-bank gate (line 295) now includes the plain unpublished Nemotron Super owner. A new alignsRecurrentCheckpointsToPrefillChunks mode captures only at fixed prefill-chunk multiples (head 300-306). This relates to T-041 and TB-007. The bank stays behind the opt-in DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY flag and is scoped by cacheSalt and model identity, consistent with the doc's existing statements. T-041 still says production has no resident-RAM tier, so a later pass could check that the doc and the threat-model wording are reconciled if the bank ships. The doc does not itself change a control.
- docs/architecture/inference.md: the supplied unit covers only head lines 1208-1343, which are unchanged context. The substantive changes are at head 25-171 and 868-869 and are not visible here. They describe the unregistered NemotronSuperLocal* bridge (text-only, no tools or media, LOAD-lease recheck, drain ordering) and should be reviewed from that patch. Nothing in the visible text shows a trust-boundary change.

No new endpoints and no auth, attestation or encryption changes are visible. This is a coverage limit, not a clearance of the inference.md changes.
